Gap Kids’ Clothes for School, Play, and Every Day

* * *

* * *

Looking for kids’ clothes at the best value? Shop Gap Factory for Gap Kids favorites made for school days, playtime, family outings, and everything in between. Find kids’ clothes designed for everyday comfort, including graphic tees, hoodies, jeans, joggers, dresses, leggings, and more. With deals on the styles kids wear most, it’s easy to build a wardrobe of kids’ outfits that work for any season and all occasions. Whether they’re heading to class, the playground, or a birthday party, Gap Factory helps you find the pieces they’ll reach for again and again.

* * *

Save on a wide range of [girls’ clothes](https://www.gapfactory.com/browse/girls?cid=1040943) and [boys' clothes](https://www.gapfactory.com/browse/boys?cid=1079661) that make getting dressed a breeze. Find denim with adjustable waistbands, activewear for recess and sports practice, uniform classics, and comfy essentials that mix and match with ease. From go-to everyday looks to outfits for celebrations and family gatherings, kids’ clothing from Gap Factory is designed to keep up with every part of a growing kid’s busy day. Find looks that fit their style and boost their confidence — the pieces they love to wear their way.

* * *

When you're shopping for kids’ clothes, Gap Factory offers everyday value on the essentials and trends they’re excited to wear. Stock up on tees, sweatshirts, pants, shorts, dresses, outerwear, and more quality pieces at the best value. Gap Factory is the one-stop shop for kids’ essentials they’ll live in all year long.
